newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jagoda sees no immediate turnaround in joblessness.
newsitem.headline: Jagoda sees no immediate turnaround in joblessness.

text.p: Federal Labour Office President Bernhard Jagoda said on Tuesday he sees no immediate turnaround in the German employment market.
"I can't yet see any significant turnaround," Jagoda told a news conference on the September unemployment data.
Compared with the last five years, growth in unemployment is slowing down, he said, but "we have not yet felt the growth impulses from the economy in the employment market."
